summary: This 8-K filing by Chart Industries provides an update on the pending acquisition by Baker Hughes, originally announced on July 28, 2025. The filing notes ongoing discussions with the European Commission regarding potential commitments to secure Phase I clearance, with an expected close in July 2026. No new deal terms, price, or structural changes are disclosed; it is purely a regulatory-status update. As a routine progress report on a previously announced merger without new material events, this filing does not constitute an independent special situation.
